title: Brian Lambert revives 90s pop rock glory with “Take This Heart”
htmlContent:
Brian Lambert's latest single, "Take This Heart," is a fantastic new song that combines the best parts of 90s music, filled with heartfelt lyrics and catchy melodies, with a modern twist that makes it exciting to listen to.

With influences from popular bands like the Goo Goo Dolls and Gin Blossoms, Lambert brings a powerful energy to the track. His passionate singing, rich guitar sounds, and solid beat grab your attention. "Take This Heart" talks about being open, staying strong, and the simple desire to connect with others. Lambert's lyrics tell a personal story that connects with many people.

https://open.spotify.com/track/5bTlmDRfXp6YWG1oVTCzMf?si=R9Z3RtkmRCGr6e1dg55WZA

In a time when music can sometimes feel temporary and trend-driven, Brian Lambert offers something lasting. "Take This Heart" reminds us why that style is still so loved today. Lambert revisits the past and makes it his own, showing that genuine rock music continues to thrive.
